import struct

with open('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/c-blosc2/tests/fuzz/corpus/frame_simple-lz4.b2frame', 'rb') as f:
    data = f.read()

# The frame header is msgpack-encoded
# Let's parse it manually based on the format from new_header_frame

# Offset 0: 0x90 + 14 = 0x9e (fixarray with 14 elements)
print(f'Byte 0: {data[0]:#x} (expect 0x9e)')

# Offset 1: 0xa8 (str with 8 elements) + 'b2frame'
print(f'Byte 1: {data[1]:#x} (expect 0xa8)')
print(f'Bytes 2-9: {data[2:10]} (expect b2frame)')

# Offset 10: 0xd2 (int32) + 4 bytes header_len
print(f'Byte 10: {data[10]:#x} (expect 0xd2)')
header_len = struct.unpack('>i', data[11:15])[0]
print(f'header_len: {header_len}')

# Offset 15: 0xcf (uint64) + 8 bytes frame_len
print(f'Byte 15: {data[15]:#x} (expect 0xcf)')
frame_len = struct.unpack('>Q', data[16:24])[0]
print(f'frame_len: {frame_len}')

# Offset 24: 0xa4 (str with 4 elements) + 4 bytes flags
print(f'Byte 24: {data[24]:#x} (expect 0xa4)')
print(f'Bytes 25-28: {data[25:29].hex()}')

# Offset 29: frame type
print(f'Byte 29 (frame_type): {data[29]}')

# Offset 30: codecs
print(f'Byte 30 (codecs): {data[30]:#x}')

# Offset 31: reserved
print(f'Byte 31 (reserved): {data[31]}')

# Offset 32: 0xd3 (int64) + 8 bytes nbytes
print(f'Byte 32: {data[32]:#x} (expect 0xd3)')
nbytes = struct.unpack('>q', data[33:41])[0]
print(f'nbytes: {nbytes}')

# Offset 41: 0xd3 (int64) + 8 bytes cbytes
print(f'Byte 41: {data[41]:#x} (expect 0xd3)')
cbytes = struct.unpack('>q', data[42:50])[0]
print(f'cbytes: {cbytes}')

# Offset 50: 0xd2 (int32) + 4 bytes typesize
print(f'Byte 50: {data[50]:#x} (expect 0xd2)')
typesize = struct.unpack('>i', data[51:55])[0]
print(f'typesize: {typesize}')

# Offset 55: 0xd2 (int32) + 4 bytes blocksize
print(f'Byte 55: {data[55]:#x} (expect 0xd2)')
blocksize = struct.unpack('>i', data[56:60])[0]
print(f'blocksize: {blocksize}')

# Offset 60: 0xd2 (int32) + 4 bytes chunksize
print(f'Byte 60: {data[60]:#x} (expect 0xd2)')
chunksize = struct.unpack('>i', data[61:65])[0]
print(f'chunksize: {chunksize}')

# Offset 65: 0xd1 (int16) + 2 bytes nthreads_c
print(f'Byte 65: {data[65]:#x} (expect 0xd1)')
nthreads_c = struct.unpack('>h', data[66:68])[0]
print(f'nthreads_c: {nthreads_c}')

# Offset 68: 0xd1 (int16) + 2 bytes nthreads_d
print(f'Byte 68: {data[68]:#x} (expect 0xd1)')
nthreads_d = struct.unpack('>h', data[69:71])[0]
print(f'nthreads_d: {nthreads_d}')

# Offset 71: has_vlmetalayers
print(f'Byte 71 (has_vlmetalayers): {data[71]:#x}')

# Offset 72: 0xd8 (fixext 16) + 1 byte nfilters + 16 bytes filters
print(f'Byte 72: {data[72]:#x} (expect 0xd8)')
nfilters = data[73]
print(f'nfilters: {nfilters}')

# nchunks = nbytes / chunksize
nchunks = nbytes // chunksize if chunksize > 0 else 0
print(f'nchunks: {nchunks}')
"
